name: Shimbashi
tagline: Toranomon in 2 minutes and Tokyo in 3 minutes. Served by 7 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by JR Tokaido Line, JR Yamanote Line, JR Yokosuka Line, JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Toei Asakusa Line and Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 9 minutes to Otemachi, 21 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 7 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 3.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 3.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.5 m to 4 m, a difference of 4.5 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 21 clinics and 11 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 十仁病院, about 163 m away and 浩邦会日比谷病院, about 422 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 7 lines serve the station: JR Tokaido Line, JR Yamanote Line, JR Yokosuka Line, JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Toei Asakusa Line and Yurikamome. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 4 lines, Tokyo Metro runs 1 line, the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line and Yurikamome runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 100.

rentRange.note: One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000 and 2LDK ¥390,000 to ¥400,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: 348 m away in a straight line. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shimbashi.
492 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 5 minutes sooner than Shimbashi. One-room rents run about ¥18,000 higher.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People who want to hold the rent down

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 7 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
